text: Illustration. A different car, April 20th account
In April, an empty Waymo was swept into Salado Creek.
observed: 15.0 to 15.2 s, option b, overhead: the car roof shifts left and rotates slightly at the bank edge. At 15.4 s a cut to a ground-level creek: brown water with rain streaks fills the lower two thirds, a white sensor-roof car sits half submerged with a reflection and a wake curving to its right, and a live oak stands on the far bank. Directly under the far-bank grass line a pale tan band of water runs straight and horizontal across the entire frame width, with straight upper and lower boundaries, in all three ground-level samples. Caption holds.
